sentences.en: The photographer used a long shot to capture the entire landscape.
sentences.zh: 摄影师使用远景镜头来拍摄整个风景。

sentences.en: In the movie, the director often uses long shots to show the vastness of the desert.
sentences.zh: 在这部电影中，导演经常使用远景镜头来展现沙漠的广阔无垠。

sentences.en: She took a long shot photo of the city skyline at sunset.
sentences.zh: 她在日落时分拍摄了整座城市的天际线远景照片。
